title: Unrestricted conditional maximum likelihood estimation for a Fréchet regression model
summary: Heavy-tailed response variables are routinely modeled as a function of covariates, but the asymptotic theory available for the resulting maximum likelihood estimators sidesteps certain technical difficulties by restricting the parameters to a compact set, which is not the natural parameter space. We consider a Fréchet model whose scale parameter depends log-linearly on a vector of covariates, while the tail parameter is constant, and we study the conditional maximum likelihood estimator of the tail parameter and the regression coefficients jointly.
